name: swiftnodes-mcp
description: Multi-chain blockchain RPC data, pricing, weekly auto-probed JSON-RPC method support, and live endpoint probing for AI agents.
long_description:
SwiftNodes is a multi-chain blockchain RPC provider: one API key across 75+ chains, flat-rate pricing, HTTP and WebSocket. This server gives AI agents live, factual answers about chains, pricing, and JSON-RPC method support (auto-probed weekly through the real customer path), plus the ability to diagnose any EVM endpoint directly.

Tools: list_chains, get_chain, get_pricing, get_method_support, probe_endpoint.

Zero dependencies, Node >= 18. No configuration or API key needed for the bundled data tools.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: List every chain SwiftNodes serves (name, slug, chain ID, category, docs page).

query.description: Optional name/slug substring filter, e.g. 'base' or 'zksync'.

evm_only.description: If true, only EVM chains are returned.

tools.name: get_chain
tools.description: Full details for one chain: IDs, endpoints, docs links.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Live flat-rate plans from the public API.

tools.name: get_method_support
tools.description: Which JSON-RPC methods work on which chain, auto-probed weekly.

tools.name: probe_endpoint
tools.description: Diagnose any EVM JSON-RPC endpoint: chain identity, height, archive capability, latency.

url.description: The http(s) RPC endpoint URL to probe.

method.description: Optional JSON-RPC method to call, e.g. 'eth_chainId'.

params.description: Optional params array for the method call.
